bull.story: Datacenter optics/LEO well above $2B, pricing holds, margins reach the low-20s in 2028; 20.5x.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q3 guide $3.70B and Q4 'above $4B' (src 1) on H1 ~$6.58B gives ~$14.3B+; S&P Global consensus $14.43B (src 6); 14,420/11,800-1 = 22.2%

Consensus FY27 $17.18B (+19.05%, src 6); Q4-26 >$4B x4 = $16B+ before datacenter 'well above $2B' (src 1). Alt-data lead-time uplift (agent_4) not added: rests partly on a blog and a paywalled headline.
FY28 ~$18.4B, just above the 2023 peak $17.3B (F1); 2023-25 fall of 32% (F1->F3) shows how upcycles end, so growth slows sharply in year 3-4 of the cycle.

H1 GAAP operating income $70M (Q1) + $187M (Q2) = $257M (src 1). Q3 ~$0.34B = guided $3.70B x 37% GM ($1.37B) less ~$1.03B GAAP opex at Q2's level (3,487 x 34.8% - 187 = $1,026M). Q4 ~$0.49B = ~11.8% on the implied ~$4.14B ($14.42B - $6.58B H1 - $3.70B Q3; guided 'above $4B'). ($257M + $343M + $487M) = ~$1.09B / $14.42B = 7.5%. Agents' values 7.5% (agents 1-4) to 8% (agent_5).

Consensus FY27 EPS $2.69 (src 6; ST non-GAAP is after SBC and excludes only restructuring and NXP-MEMS PPA, src 1) x 913.7M = $2.46B; / (1 - 0.18) = ~$3.00B pretax; less ~$0.1B net interest income (H1 2026 interest income $80M vs expense $28M, src 2) = ~$2.9B non-GAAP EBIT = ~16.9% of $17.18B; less ~1.9pts restructuring + PPA ($58M + $24M a quarter in Q2 x 4 = $328M) = ~15%.

ST's 2027-28 intermediate model is ~$18B revenue at a 22-24% operating margin (src 32), with the $18B 2028 revenue model reaffirmed on the Q2 2026 call (src 33). Bottom-up: GM 42-43% x $18.4B = $7.7-7.9B less ~$4.2B opex (Q3 non-GAAP net opex ~$980M/qtr, src 33) and ~$0.1B PPA = ~19-20%; 19% / 19.5% sits 3-5pts below management's model for SiC losses and Chinese price competition, below the 2023 peak 26.7% (F5/F1).

ST's 2026 estimated annual effective rate is 18.1% before discrete items incl. 0.5pt Pillar Two, down from 19.3% actual in 2025 on profit mix (src 2, Q2 OFR). FY23 11.4% (541/4,763, F43/F47) and FY24 16.7% (313/1,878, F44/F48) predate Pillar Two and included discrete items, so they are not used to go below the company's own figure.
FY25 1,854/11,800 = 15.7%; D&A ~flat in dollars as revenue grows.

FY26: ST guides 2026 net capex 'in the high end of the $2.0 to $2.2 billion range' (src 2, Q2 OFR); 15.2% x reconciled FY26 revenue $14.42B = $2.19B, in the high end (2,200 / 14,420 = 15.26% at the top). The % is derived, not guided. FY27-29 have no company guidance: supervisor estimate holding net capex ~$2.1B a year as the reshaping programme completes (end-2027): 12.5% x $17.16B = $2.14B, 11.5% x $18.36B = $2.11B, 11% x $19.10B = $2.10B.
FY25 193/11,800 = 1.6%; ST's non-GAAP does not add SBC back (src 1), so EPS here and consensus are both after SBC.
Adjusted net financial position = NFP $2,007M less $306M capital-grant advances for capex not yet incurred (src 1); used because projected capex is net of grants.

Noncontrolling interest in total equity at 2026-06-27 (Q2 OFR equity statement and balance sheet, src 2); book value as the claim on consolidated cash flows. NCI share of net income is ~$12-18M/yr (Q2 $3M, H1 $9M), too small to adjust EPS.

Basic: 911,281,920 issued (src 2, Q2 balance sheet) - 15,930,103 treasury after the Oct 5-9 buybacks (src 29) = 895.35M (assumes no new issuance; the Tranche B net-share settlement was delivered from treasury: treasury fell from 19.35M on Aug 25 to 15.58M on Oct 2). + stock awards 7.70M (Q2 diluted-EPS table, src 2) + customer warrants by treasury method 24.8M x (1 - 28.38/49.57) = 10.61M (src 2) = 913.66M. The 17.31M convertible-bond shares in the Q2 table are excluded: Tranche B principal was paid in cash with the excess in shares (now in basic), and the 2031/2033 bonds are out of the money with principal in debt.
Diluted count 944.2M -> 923.1M over 2023-25 (~-1.1%/yr) with ~$360M/yr buybacks; at a higher price the same budget buys fewer shares.

Raw beta 1.67 = mean of 1.48 (StockAnalysis 5Y, src 7), 1.97 (supervisor's 5Y monthly regression of STM on SPY, src 20/21, reproducing agent_5) and 1.56 (2Y weekly, src 22); Blume 0.67 x 1.67 + 0.33 = 1.45. Cost of equity 5.24% (src 8) + 1.45 x 4.20% (Damodaran implied ERP 2026-10-01, src 19) = 11.33%. Debt $4,025M - $750M Tranche B = $3.27B (src 2) vs ~$45.3B equity (913.7M x $49.57) = 6.7% at ~3.5% after tax. 0.933 x 11.33% + 0.067 x 3.5% = 10.8%.
Same as all five forecasters; analog/power content growth slightly above nominal GDP. TV is 86% of DCF, so the DCF gets only 35% weight.

model.reasoning: Each driver comes from the evidence, not an average. Revenue follows guidance and consensus through FY27 (Q4 >$4B, consensus $17.18B), then slows to +7%/+4% because upcycles end (2023-25: -32%). GAAP margins are 15% in FY27 (consensus EPS less verified restructuring/PPA) and 19-19.5% after, 3-5pts under management's 22-24% 2027-28 model given SiC losses and capital intensity. Tax is the guided 18%. WACC is 10.8%: sourced 4.20% ERP, raw beta 1.67 from three measurements, Blume 1.45. The per-share bridge uses the filings: adjusted net cash $1,701M, minorities $406M, and 913.7M diluted shares (895.35M basic after the Tranche B delivery, plus awards and customer warrants by treasury method). SBC is costed once in GAAP EBIT; the warrants' small contra-revenue stays in margins, as for unvested awards. The valuation is 17x NTM GAAP EPS (corrected next-FY peer median 16.56x, ~17.5x like-for-like) blended 65/35 with the DCF, whose TV is 86% of value. Scenario spread is 0.30 so the distribution matches the 61%-vol history. Engine: base $47.59, median $46.6, q25-q75 $33.2-62.8; 17x implies a 9.5% WACC.

set_review.main_issue: Sound structure; 900M shares omit 10.6M warrant shares and higher basic; no minorities; 17% tax; 17.5x a touch above the corrected 16.56x median after SBC lift.
Shares and tax now right; low on FY28-29 margins (18/18.5% from an assumed 41% GM) and 16.5x; no minorities.
FY27 +17% below the Q4 run-rate and consensus; 40% weight on a TV-heavy DCF; 900M shares; 17% tax; no minorities.
Minorities and capex right; 10.4% WACC on beta 1.32 only; 17% tax from FY27; FY28-29 margins at the top of the range.
2026 capex 12% against the guided ~15%; 16x on a trailing-history discount; 900M shares; 17% tax; no minorities; margins lean on an unseen Barclays note.
